mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a canonical ten-period Ehlers Center of Gravity oscillator crossing its one-bar trigger on completed four-hour BTC auctions identifies a reversal in the balance point of median prices; follow the new relation for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when COG crosses strictly above its one-bar-lag trigger; short on the strict reverse crossover
mechanism.why_distinct: Ehlers COG uses position-weighted completed median prices divided by their price sum and is centered by (length+1)/2, then crosses its own one-bar trigger. It is not a moving-average price spread, return oscillator, prior control, volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse weighted median-price balance-point reversals are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.cog: negative position-weighted sum over latest 10 uninterrupted median prices divided by their sum, plus 5.5; i=0 is current completed bar
features.event: current finite nonzero COG-trigger sign differs from immediately prior finite nonzero sign
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed one-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical Ehlers COG(10) trigger crossover under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no COG period, price basis, weighting, centering, crossing, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: John F. Ehlers Center of Gravity oscillator convention
external_basis.fixed_definition: length 10 median price; COG=-sum((i+1)*median_price[t-i])/sum(median_price[t-i])+(length+1)/2; trigger is prior completed COG; line crossover direction
external_basis.selection_use: published length, median-price formula, trigger, and crossover direction only; no incidence or outcomes
